repositories.name: Angular-Weather-App
repositories.description: This application utilizes Rapid API's Current Weather API to retrieve weather data and presents the acquired information through the user interface. It encompasses a feature that enables users to search for specific city or country names, resulting in the retrieval of corresponding weather data.

repositories.name: Algo-Test
repositories.description: This application utilizes BANK NIFTY data ([Timestamp, LTP, Volume]) and Lightweight Charts Library to render it as a chart. It also converts the data into Open High Low Close (OHLC) format, with the ability to specify resolution.

repositories.name: Build-Plotter
repositories.description: This repository hosts a Python script that creates bar graphs from a build log (build-stats.txt). The script visualizes page sizes and first load JS, aiding in comparing different builds of a web application.

repositories.name: Express.js-Basics
repositories.description: The basics of building a server using Express.js which is a popular web application framework for Node.js. It provides a robust set of features and tools to build web applications and APIs quickly and efficiently.

repositories.name: Monitor-Application
repositories.description: This app uses pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) and a magnetometer to track the number of steps taken and the direction of your walk. The app also differentiates between stairs and lift usage and has an easy-to-use UI. It's built using Kotlin..

repositories.name: Virtual-Screening
repositories.description: It performs virtual screening against the active site of a protein using Ligands.txt file in SDF format (3D) and lists the top 30 best binding drugs. It also generates a distribution plot of the binding energies for all drug molecules.

repositories.name: Homology-Modelling
repositories.description: This repository contains code for protein structure modeling and evaluation. It downloads a FASTA sequence (UniProt ID), models the native structure, generates mutant models, and evaluates them using the DOPE score. A native-mutant DOPE score profile plot is also included for the best model.

repositories.name: Sensor-Application
repositories.description: An Application which uses the Light, Proximity and Geomagnetic Rotation Vector Sensor of an Android Phone and displays the data received in the UI. The app also calculates a user's position in reference to Earth's Magnetic North Pole and gives feedback to align with it. It stores all the data returned by the Sensors in the Room Database.
